headline: Treasury spent ten days trailing an economic D-Day on Iran, then spared the banks that clear four-fifths of the oil.
stance: Roughly 60 designations landed Monday afternoon and not one major Chinese bank was among them, though China lifts more than 80% of Iran's seaborne crude. Brent sold it twice, the long end took the disinflation, and a 2y auction prices this afternoon.

news.head: Iran sanctions land without the Chinese banks
news.body: The list runs through shipping, gold, aviation and digital assets, with brokers and shadow-fleet vessels named in the UAE, Hong Kong and Singapore.

news.head: Crude sells the announcement a second time
news.body: Brent $91.27, -1.0% (~2:30am ET), after Monday settled down more than 2%. Two sessions of selling read economic coercion as less supply risk than strikes.

news.head: Pro Farmer tour puts corn at a three-year high
news.body: A seven-state survey found crops in worse shape than expected. Corn and wheat are each up about 12% this month, the day before the core PCE print.

implications: Sanctions that spare the buyer of four-fifths of Iran's barrels are a headline, not a supply event. What is left to price is Hormuz, and that is a freight and insurance risk.
The September strip prices a 42.1% chance of a hike (~5:40am ET). Tomorrow's release is the last data that can move that before the chair speaks Friday.

watch.head: 2-year note auction, this afternoon
watch.body: First of three coupons this week, 5y Wednesday and 7y Thursday, and the only one that prices before tomorrow's inflation number.

watch.head: Consumer confidence and new home sales, 10am ET
watch.body: The only tier-2 US data today. Case-Shiller at 9am covers June, three months behind the Canada duties and no use for reading them.

watch.head: Core PCE, Q2 GDP and durable goods, 8:30am Wednesday
watch.body: Three releases in one minute, then the 5y auction that afternoon and Nvidia after the close. One session carries the whole week's risk.

watch.head: Warsh at Jackson Hole, Friday
watch.body: The symposium runs Aug 27-29 and the keynote is his first as chair. He speaks two days after the print with a hike still live in the strip.

sections.title: Macro & Rates
bullets: Two sessions running, the long end did the work and the front did none. Growth-and-supply repricing, not a Fed one, and today's auction tests the part that has not moved.
Neither the oil break nor the grain squeeze reaches tomorrow's number, which covers July. Both land in August data, and they point opposite ways.
Gold sits at a 15-week high, not a record. GVZ rose to 28.28 while OVX fell to 46.74: hedging demand moved from the barrel to the bar in one session.
sections.positioning: Standing background, not news: spec net long 2y Treasury has been pinned at the 100th %ile of three years for four weeks, with hedgers at the opposite extreme. It prices today.

sections.title: Equity Markets
bullets: Monday was a rotation, not a de-risking. Blue chips took the money that came out of chips, with Nvidia off 1.9% into its own print.
Nasdaq 100 +0.64%, S&P 500 +0.33%, Dow +0.22% (~5:40am ET). This morning buys back what yesterday sold, and a two-day round trip is positioning, not a view.
sections.positioning: Spec net short Nasdaq 100 sits at the 3rd %ile of three years, unchanged for three weeks. Whatever is at risk into tomorrow night, it is not a consensus long in the futures.

single_name.note: Elanco - new to the screen today on an insider buy filed Aug 21, above its 200-day, 7.3 days to cover. Animal health is as far from the AI print as the screen gets.

sections.title: Credit & Liquidity
bullets: The spreads on the tape are Friday's marks. Nothing in credit has priced the sanctions, the oil break, or a week carrying three coupon auctions.
With the Fed's overnight facility effectively empty, a three-auction settlement week drains bank reserves directly rather than the facility that used to take it.
sections.positioning: Primary-dealer investment-grade inventory sits mid-range at the 53rd %ile, so no dealer balance-sheet stress goes into the supply. That is the pre-condition for quiet auctions.

single_name.note: Chicago Atlantic - three insider rules fired and a filing dated Aug 21, above its 200-day. A mortgage REIT lender is a levered read on the front end holding.
